title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics telemetry enhancements
author: Ethan Cole
release_notes: Adds richer telemetry for oncall diagnostics: runbook_suggested_count, suggestion_latency_ms, diagnostic_trace_id mapping. No user-visible API changes.
body: Motivation: Improve observability for incident-bot oncall diagnostics so SREs can trace which automated suggestions/runbooks were surfaced during an incident, measure suggestion latency and success rates, and correlate suggestions to SLO traces. This change adds telemetry hooks to the diagnostics pipeline, instruments runbook suggestion selection, and emits tracing/span attributes for downstream correlation. Summary of changes: 1) add metrics counters and histograms: incidentbot.runbook_suggested_count, incidentbot.suggestion_latency_ms, incidentbot.suggestion_outcome{accepted,rejected,not_shown}; 2) attach trace/diagnostic ids to suggestion messages and include span context propagation for distributed traces; 3) add tagging for SLO-related diagnostics so the SLO-toolkit can link alerts to suggestions; 4) add a feature flag incidentbot.telemetry.v2 for gradual rollout and an opt-out via config; 5) tests for metrics emission and trace propagation; 6) docs and release notes. Checklist: - [x] Metrics counters/histograms implemented - [x] Span attributes and trace id propagation added - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Feature flag for staged rollout - [x] Documentation updates - [x] Linear ticket linked (ENG-2310, ENG-2387) How to validate: follow README/testing.md to run the oncall diagnostics integration test which asserts counters and histogram buckets, run e2e with observability sandbox to verify trace id shows up in APM and in SLO-toolkit traces, deploy behind feature flag and run smoke tests. Impact: adds telemetry only and uses opt-in/gradual rollout, no changes to public APIs or runbook text content. Related: builds on prior work ENG-1705 (compact runbook linking) and incident-bot telemetry refactors ENG-1980.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) Add telemetry primitives, feature flag and basic hooks; 2) Wire trace id propagation into diagnostics pipeline and tests; 3) Docs and config updates, tests fixes after CI failures.
changed_files_summary: High-level files changed: src/diagnostics/telemetry.ts, src/diagnostics/suggestion_engine.ts, src/diagnostics/runbook_linker.ts, src/config/feature_flags.ts, test/integration/diagnostics-telemetry.test.ts, docs/observability/oncall-telemetry.md, charts/values.yaml (feature flag default off), ci/test-playbook.yaml, package.json (dev deps). Small illustrative snippet: added span attribute 'incidentbot.diagnostic_id' and metric emit call metrics.histogram('incidentbot.suggestion_latency_ms', latencyMs).
review_comments: Priya Nair: Please add a note about cardinality for tags; high-cardinality labels like raw user IDs are dangerous for metrics. Can we sanitize or hash any PII before tagging?
Ethan Cole: Good catch, added scrub_and_hash() util and added unit tests to ensure PII is not emitted verbatim.
Lina Morales: Integration tests flaked on CI initially (race in tracer initialization), consider adding a tracer-ready hook or retry with backoff.
Ethan Cole: Added tracer.ready() check and a retry with small backoff; re-ran tests locally and in CI.
Marco Ruiz: Approve after addressing test flakiness and adding feature flag. Left a nit about naming of metric 'runbook_hit_count' vs 'runbook_suggested_count'.
Ethan Cole: Renamed to runbook_suggested_count to be more explicit; updated docs and alerts.
CI: initial test run failed due to missing mock for tracer in unit tests; fixed in second commit and CI passed.
